issue: New entries do not persist after page reload
actual: Added entry "Test Entry Alpha" (Priority 42, Due Date Sep 10 2026, Completed Yes, Notes "Sample note text") appeared immediately in the table (6 entries). After reloading http://localhost:6074/, the entry list reverted to the original 5 seed entries and the new entry was gone; the field configuration itself also reset, confirming no persistence layer.
evidence: Table row count went 5 -> 6 after add, then back to 5 after navigate reload.
Configure Fields dialog: added field "Notes" with type Text; it immediately appeared as a new column header in the table and as a new labeled text input in the Add Entry form.

Entered Task Name text "Test Entry Alpha", Priority number 42, Due Date 2026-09-10, Completed checkbox Yes, Notes text "Sample note text" via Add/Edit Entry forms. All five values (text, number, date, checkbox, second text field) are retained and displayed identically in both Table view (row cells) and Card view (field rows) after switching.
Switched Table -> Cards -> Table; entry count stayed at 6 and every field value (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) for each of the 6 entries was identical across both views.

issue: Empty field value not given a clear placeholder in either view
actual: Entries with an unset (undefined) Notes value show a "—" placeholder consistently in both Table and Card views. However, when a new entry is created leaving the Notes text field blank (empty string ""), the cell/card row renders with no text and no "—" placeholder at all (blank), differing from the undefined case. So an explicit empty value has no clear representation, unlike the unset case.
evidence: Row "Test Entry Alpha 42 Sep 10, 2026" (no trailing dash) vs other rows "... Jan 15, 2026 —"; Card for Test Entry Alpha showed bare "Notes" label with no value line, vs other cards showing "Notes" + "—".

Configure Fields dialog shows explicit type labels "Text", "Number", "Date", "Checkbox" in each field's type combobox. Add/Edit Entry forms render type-appropriate controls: plain textbox for text field, spinbutton for number field, date input (type=date) for date field, and a checkbox with Yes/No label for checkbox field.

Entry form checkbox toggles between "Completed No" (unchecked) and "Completed Yes" [checked] with adjacent text label switching No/Yes. Table and Card views render a distinct icon plus explicit "Yes"/"No" text for the Completed field per entry.

Priority field in Add Entry form is rendered as a native input[type=number] spinbutton. Attempting to type a non-numeric string ("abc") into it was rejected by the control itself (Playwright reported "Cannot type text into input[type=number]"), so no non-numeric value can ever be entered/saved for that field.

Due Date field in Add Entry form is a native input[type=date]. Attempting to fill an invalid calendar date ("2026-13-45", month 13 / day 45) was rejected by the control itself ("Malformed value" error), preventing an invalid date from ever being entered/saved.

Set Table view sort to Priority (toggled to descending: 42,3,2,2,1,1). Switched to Cards view: sort reset to none (default manual order, "Drag entries to reorder" shown). Set Cards view sort to Task Name (ascending, alphabetical order). Switched back to Table view: it still showed "Sorted by Priority (descending)" with the same descending order, confirming table and card sort selections are stored independently.

Clicking "Priority" in the Sort menu immediately reordered the table rows ascending (1,1,2,2,3,42) and displayed "Sorted by Priority (ascending)" with the Sort button relabeled "Priority" (active). Clicking the Priority column header toggled to descending (42,3,2,2,1,1) and footer updated to "Sorted by Priority (descending)". App remained fully interactive afterward (menus, add entry, view toggle all functioned).
Before and after sorting by Priority (ascending then descending), entry count remained 6 and each entry's Task Name/Priority/Due Date/Completed/Notes values were unchanged, only row order changed.

With no sort active, used the keyboard-accessible drag handle (Space to pick up, Arrow keys to move, Space to drop) to move "Design new landing page" from position 1 to position 2 in Table view (order became Review, Design, Update, Prepare, Team sync, Test Entry Alpha). Switched to Cards view: order was still the original insertion order (unaffected by table reorder), confirming independent state. Reordered Cards view (moved Design new landing page to position 5). Switched back to Table view: table still showed its own earlier reorder (Review, Design, Update, Prepare, Team sync, Test Entry Alpha) unaffected by the card reorder, confirming each view keeps its own manual order.

issue: No filter feature is exposed in the UI
actual: Searched the entire toolbar and table/card views for any filter control (button text, aria-label, icon, class name, or on-hover affordance containing "filter"). Only Fields, Sort, Table/Cards view toggle, Add Entry, and a free-text Search box exist. No UI element lets a user define field-specific filter criteria (e.g., "Priority > 2" or "Completed = Yes"). The feature described by FT-6 could not be located or exercised.
evidence: DOM query for buttons/elements with "filter" in text, aria-label, id, or class returned zero matches; body innerText contains no occurrence of the word "filter".

issue: No filter feature is exposed in the UI
actual: Since no filter control exists anywhere in the app (see FT-6 finding), it is impossible to define active filter criteria, so the requirement that filtering include exactly the matching entries and clearing restore all entries cannot be exercised or verified.
evidence: Same DOM search as FT-6 found no filter UI.

Typed lowercase "design" into the search box; result narrowed to the single entry "Design new landing page" (case-insensitive substring match) and the footer count updated to '1 entry matching "design"'. Clicking the clear (x) button in the search box restored all 6 entries.

issue: Quick search does not match displayed/formatted field values for date or checkbox fields
actual: Searching "Jan 15" (the exact formatted Due Date text shown for "Design new landing page": "Jan 15, 2026") returned 0 results ("0 entries matching \"Jan 15\""). Searching "Yes" (the exact Completed text shown for several entries) also returned 0 results. Search appears to only match the Task Name/Notes text fields and internal raw values, not the human-readable formatted date or checkbox labels users see in the views.
evidence: Footer showed "0 entries matching \"Jan 15\"" and "0 entries matching \"Yes\"" despite those exact strings being visibly rendered in the table for multiple entries.

issue: No import feature is exposed in the UI
actual: Searched the whole app (toolbar, Configure Fields dialog, table/card views) for an import control. The Configure Fields dialog only shows a note stating "Configure fields before importing data" but provides no actual Import button, file picker, or paste-data control anywhere in the app. A DOM-wide text search for "import" (case-insensitive) found no matches besides that static note. The import capability described by FT-19 could not be located or exercised.
evidence: document.body.innerText search for /import/i matched nothing outside the static help text; no Import button found among toolbar or dialog buttons.
